moves.text: I enter as counsel, not conjurer: I can identify the author, but I cannot subpoena the present rights-holder. Joke rank 1: “I wrote the book, which proves I’m qualified to discuss permission—and spectacularly unqualified to assume I possess it.”

moves.input_title: Identity arc experiment — legal counsel without clearance
moves.text: Leonardo offers the adaptation; Agnolo asks for clearance; Borges produces the blocked receipt. Joke rank 2: “Consent in rehearsal is like applause in court: encouraging, audible, and entirely incapable of transferring copyright.” We test an original scene instead.

I hold up the receipt: access_blocked, zero bytes, unknown cost, no request ID. Joke rank 3: “A status URL is not a license; it is merely a very confident envelope containing no permission.” The archive gets its shelf mark, and invention gets no forged signature.

Time-skip to the press conference: I interrupt myself before anyone says ‘the author approved it.’ “Excellent,” I say, “we have historical authorship, creative influence, and no demonstrated authorization—the legal trinity, with one member conspicuously absent.” We proceed only with newly made material.
